summary: First testing iteration for Nail's Passion PWA. Comprehensive backend pytest suite (19 tests) for all CRUD + auth endpoints — 100% pass. Frontend Playwright sweep of all 7 screens + booking flow + admin flow — fully functional. All required data-testids present. Backend seeded correctly with 6 prestations and 9 gallery items. Admin PIN 1234 works. Booking submission shows success screen.

minor.issue: Status passed as query param (?status=confirmed) instead of body — works but inconsistent with REST conventions; consider Pydantic body model.
ADMIN_TOKENS is an in-memory set; tokens are wiped on backend restart and not shared across workers. Acceptable for MVP but flag for production.

issues: Uses native browser date/time picker (<input type='date'/time'>) instead of shadcn calendar/time picker — system prompt explicitly flags this as a design issue to surface.

React console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Root cause is the build-tool instrumentation injecting <span data-ve-dynamic> wrappers inside <option> on line 98 of BookingScreen.jsx. Functionally OK but produces noisy hydration warnings.

action_items: Consider replacing native date/time inputs in BookingScreen.jsx with a shadcn Calendar + time selector for design parity with the rest of the dark/neon theme.
Optional: change PUT /api/bookings/{id}/status to use a body payload for cleaner API design.
Optional: move ADMIN_TOKENS to MongoDB (or signed JWT) so admin sessions survive backend restarts and scale across workers.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: solid structure (~400 lines), proper async/await, _id always excluded via projection. Pydantic ConfigDict(extra='ignore') used appropriately.
BottomNav active-tab pop-up uses negative translate which causes the icon to overlap the 'Made with Emergent' badge in the bottom-right during automated tests; users on real devices unaffected.

Settings model defaults are hard-coded in code (admin_pin='1234' default). Acceptable for MVP; flag for production: admin PIN should be hashed and configurable only via env, not exposed even by GET /api/settings (currently /settings returns the pin to anyone — only /settings/public hides it). Suggest restricting /api/settings to admin auth as well.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 6 prestations + 9 gallery items on startup. No additional seeding required. Test data created during runs uses TEST_ prefix and is cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is pytest-based; run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from env. All 19 tests passing as of this iteration. Admin login token is short-lived only across backend restart (in-memory). To exercise frontend Contact tab via BottomNav click, navigate directly to /contact — the 'Made with Emergent' badge can intercept the nav-contact button at viewport 414x896.
rca of the issue: No bugs to RCA in this iteration. All requested features verified working end-to-end.
